children.text: Building on this legacy, the Umm Al Quwain campus was inaugurated in September 2014 with an initial cohort of 200 students from Kindergarten through Grade 7. In 10 years, the UAQ campus has flourished to serve approximately 1,425 learners from KG1 to Grade 12, of whom 86% are Emiratis, 10% are other Arab expatriates, and 4% hail from non-Arab backgrounds such as Russia and Canada.

Today, SAIS - UAQ, under the leadership of Ms. Carole Sarkis Abboud, serves four different phases - Kindergarten, Elementary, Middle School, and High School. Our multicultural faculty represents over ten nationalities, including educators from Canada, the United States, New Zealand, South Africa, Lebanon, Syria, Jordan, Egypt, Romania, and Armenia. The campus itself features 59 classrooms, four staff rooms, a Head of Department office, dedicated art and computer labs, four science laboratories, a library, gymnasium, canteens, prayer rooms, multiple playgrounds and swimming pools, a bookstore, and a full suite of administrative and support facilities.

children.text: Our curriculum is guided by the AERO (American Education Reaches Out) standards, which provide a clear and consistent framework across all subjects and grade levels. These standards help our teachers design thoughtful, engaging lessons that build essential knowledge and skills.

Using AERO, we ensure that students are not only meeting academic benchmarks but also developing critical thinking, creativity, and real-world problem-solving abilities. Lessons are flexible and student-centered, allowing teachers to adapt instruction based on individual strengths, interests, and learning styles.

In addition to core subjects, students can choose from a wide variety of elective and AP courses to deepen our learner's knowledge and ensure their college readiness. Whether through core classes, electives, or AP courses, our goal is to prepare students to thrive in school and in the world ahead.

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ teacher guiding two students in class

children.text: Our staff communicate with stakeholders through various channels to ensure students' well-being and academic success. Teachers create an inclusive environment by planning lessons that meet the needs of all learners, including students of determination and those who are gifted and talented. Student-led national and international events are regularly held at the school, helping students stay actively engaged with the wider community.

At SAIS - UAQ, we are committed to preparing our students to become lifelong learners who are curious, resilient, and driven to grow. We focus on developing strong character values such as integrity, respect, and responsibility. Through academic and personal development, we encourage our students to contribute positively to their community and make a meaningful difference in the world around them.

Today, the role of a school is not only to pursue academic excellence but also to motivate and empower its students to be lifelong learners, critical thinkers, and productive members of an ever-changing global society.

At Sharjah American International School, we foster a productive learning environment that accommodates students’ unique needs and empower them to thrive for excellence. This can only be possible in a holistic, student-centered environment, where teachers as facilitators of learning differentiate instruction to support diverse learning styles, identify and nurture individual talents, skills, and abilities of students, and encourage them to achieve their full potential. Teachers provide students with a platform to think critically, express, and exhibit their knowledge and skills, and positively contribute to the community.

We strongly believe in the importance of teachers, parents, and administrators collaborating and communicating openly and frequently to improve students’ performance and well-being. The consistent support of the parents has empowered us to do more and more. I pay my gratitude to them for their trust in us.
I am confident that all our students are equipped with the essential skills to face future challenges with confidence and are poised to make a meaningful impact on tomorrow’s society.

Please enjoy exploring our website. You will find important and relevant information about our school. We will also be delighted to welcome you for a tour of our spacious classrooms and extensive facilities.

children.text: The Elementary School offers a nurturing and engaging environment where students begin their academic journey with curiosity, confidence, and joy.

heading.title: Building Strong Foundations for Deeper Learning

children.text: Elementary provides a dynamic and supportive learning environment where students are encouraged to grow academically, socially, emotionally, and personally. We believe that these foundational years play a vital role in shaping confident, responsible, and lifelong learners, which is why we focus on nurturing each child’s individual strengths, interests, and abilities. Through meaningful learning experiences and positive relationships, students develop independence, self-confidence, creativity, and strong character while learning to collaborate respectfully and engage positively within a diverse community. Our goal is to inspire students to become curious learners, critical thinkers, and active participants in their educational journey while fostering a genuine love of learning that extends beyond the classroom.

children.text: The curriculum is designed to provide students with strong academic foundations while promoting inquiry, creativity, collaboration, and real-world application of learning. Integrated with internationally recognized standards, the curriculum strengthens essential skills in literacy, mathematics, science, communication, and problem-solving through engaging and interdisciplinary learning experiences. Students are encouraged to think critically, explore new ideas, and make meaningful connections across subject areas through hands-on activities, project-based learning, and collaborative experiences.

Technology integration is an essential component of the curriculum, with Interactive Boards, digital learning resources, and specialized educational applications enhancing engagement, innovation, and student-centered learning. Through a balanced approach that combines academic rigor with creativity and exploration, students develop the confidence, curiosity, organization, and self-management skills necessary for future academic success and lifelong learning.

children.text: At the Elementary level, assessment is designed to support student growth, confidence, and skill development. Students are assessed through a balanced approach that includes quizzes, tests, formative assessments, performance-based tasks, classroom observations, projects, and practical activities.

A strong emphasis is placed on performance assessments, allowing students to demonstrate their understanding through real-life tasks, hands-on activities, presentations, and creative work. These assessments help teachers evaluate not only what students know, but also how they apply their learning in meaningful contexts.

heading.title: A Caring Environment for Growing Minds

children.text: We understand that the early years are among the most important stages in a child’s development, shaping not only academic readiness, but also social skills, emotional well-being, creativity, independence, and self-confidence.

Our Kindergarten classrooms are designed to foster a sense of belonging where children feel safe, valued, and motivated to explore the world around them through meaningful experiences and positive relationships. Integrated with AERO, NGSS standards, and MOE curriculum for subjects taught in Arabic.

Our curriculum focuses on building strong foundations in literacy and numeracy in both English and Arabic while also promoting communication, critical thinking, problem-solving, and social-emotional development. Learning takes place through inquiry-based activities, thematic units, imaginative and guided play, collaborative experiences, and real-world connections that make learning meaningful and enjoyable for young children.

Teachers assess students' progress in communication and language, physical development, personal and social skills, cognitive development, and creativity.
Assessment is integrated into daily classroom activities, play-based learning, and interactions to ensure a holistic understanding of each child's growth, strengths, and areas for further support.

children.text: Our admissions team is here to guide you through each step of the application process and answer any questions you may have. We welcome families who are looking for a school that combines academic excellence, strong values, and meaningful opportunities for personal growth.
All tuition fees must be settled on or before the specified due dates as defined in the payment plan.
The registration fee is deducted from tuition fees upon enrollment.
An early payment discount is available for full payment made before the commencement of Term One.
For post-dated cheques (PDC), amounts will be considered paid only after successful clearance and credit to the school’s bank account.
A service charge of AED 500 will be applied for any cheques returned by the bank.
Parents/guardians will be billed for any damage to school property caused by their child.
The registration fee is non-refundable and non-transferable under all circumstances.
School books and uniforms are non-refundable items.

Parents or guardians who pay the full tuition fee for the upcoming academic year on or before August 20 will receive a 10% discount on the tuition portion of their fees. This is the only discount available under our policy.

Refunds are governed by the UAE Ministry of Education decree. Parents/guardians must submit a written withdrawal notice at least 30 days before the requested withdrawal date, along with a formal refund request.
1.  Withdrawal Prior to the Academic Year Start
Request Initiated by Parent/Guardian
The balance of the Term 1 tuition fee (after deducting the Registration and Admissions Fees) will be refunded.
Registration and Admissions Fees are strictly non-refundable.
Request Initiated by the School
The full amount of the Term 1 tuition fee will be refunded, except for the Registration Fee (which remains non-refundable).
2.  Withdrawal During the School Term

If a student attends any portion of the first week of term or fails to attend entirely without providing at least one week’s written notice before term start, the school reserves the right to retain the Registration (or Re-registration) Fee in full.
If a student attends for two weeks or less during that term, the school may charge one full month’s tuition.
If a student attends for more than two weeks but less than one month in the term, the school may charge two full months’ tuition.
If a student attends for more than one month in the term, the school may charge the entire term’s tuition fee.
For the purposes of these calculations, one month’s tuition is defined as one-tenth of the total annual school fees.

children.text: At Sharjah American International School – UAQ Campus (SAIS - UAQ), we are committed to nurturing the holistic well-being of both students and staff.

Our comprehensive Well-Being Framework rests on four pillars (emotional, social, mental, and physical health) and is woven into every aspect of school life, from classroom routines to campus-wide initiatives. Through these layered supports and proactive initiatives, SAIS - UAQ fosters an environment where every member of our community (students and staff alike) feels seen, supported, and empowered to thrive.

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ students smiling in class

children.text: Licensed Counseling Team:
We employ a full-time school counselor and assistant counselors who provide individual check-ins, small-group workshops, and crisis intervention as needed.
Open-Door Policy:
Every student and staff member may schedule drop-in sessions or refer peers, ensuring timely support for academic stress, interpersonal conflicts, or personal challenges.
Parent & Family Outreach:
Counselors host regular webinars and one-on-one conferences to equip families with strategies for supporting well-being at home.

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ student smiling while working on a craft activity

children.text: Curriculum Integration: Our SEL curriculum runs from Kindergarten through Grade 12, with age-appropriate competencies, self-awareness, self-management, social awareness, relationship skills, and responsible decision-making taught through homeroom lessons, art, and PE sessions.
SEL Coaches: Trained staff lead fortnightly classroom circles, role-play activities, and reflective journaling to help students practice empathy, resilience, and effective communication.

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ teacher guiding two students through a hands-on SEL activity

children.text: Mindfulness & Restorative Practices:
Daily “mindful minutes” and monthly restorative circles give students and teachers tools to regulate emotions and resolve conflicts constructively.
Professional Development:
Faculty participate in ongoing workshops on SEL facilitation techniques, stress-management strategies, and inclusive classroom practices.
Peer-Support Networks:
Student wellbeing ambassadors collaborate with counselors to organize “buddy check-ins” and peer-led wellness clubs.

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ students exploring classroom learning activities

children.text: Healthy Lifestyle Week:
A dedicated week each term featuring myriad activities.
Annual Sports Day & Fitness Clubs:
From track relays to yoga and dance clubs, we promote daily physical activity as a cornerstone of mental and physical health.
Mental Health Awareness Days:
Quarterly events with guest speakers, stress-relief stations (e.g., art-therapy corners, relaxation tents), and student-led panels.

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ students playing volleyball on the school court

children.text: Speaking Corner:
Each section features a dedicated Speaking Corner (part of our SEL program) where students can share thoughts, practice communication skills, and seek peer or counselor support.
Collaborative Planning:
Teachers and counselors co-design lesson plans that infuse academic topics with social-emotional check-points and opportunities for cooperative learning.
Feedback Loops:
Regular surveys of students and staff inform ongoing refinements to our Well-Being Framework, ensuring it remains responsive to community needs.

children.text: We understand that a safe, reliable journey to and from school is essential for both students’ peace of mind and parents’ confidence. Our school transportation service is designed to deliver the highest standards of comfort, security, and efficiency.

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ students running on the school track

children.text: Modern, Well-Maintained Fleet:
All vehicles undergo daily inspections and routine maintenance to ensure peak performance and reliability.
Qualified Drivers & Escorts:
Each bus is operated by a licensed driver with extensive experience in student transport, assisted by a trained attendant who supervises boarding and disembarking.
Safe Pick-Up & Drop-Off Points:
We establish designated stops throughout Umm Al Quwain and surrounding neighborhoods, each supervised by school staff to guarantee orderly and secure transitions.
Strict Safety Protocols:

From mandatory seat belts to regular vehicle sanitization, our protocols comply with all UAE health and safety regulations. We conduct regular emergency drills to ensure students and staff are prepared for any situation.
